architecture.persistence: SQLite + better-sqlite3 behind a Repository Pattern (ADR-0002)

masterStateGovernanceRule.statement: A material GHARIBO decision affecting architecture, training, datasets, experiments, models, knowledge graph, procurement intelligence, integrations, security/IP or roadmap is NOT an accepted project decision until (1) governance/GHARIBO_MASTER_STATE.json is updated, (2) validation passes, (3) required ADR/doc updates are completed, and (4) the change is checkpointed in Git.

decisions.title: Next.js Route Handlers as the application backend
decisions.decision: Use Next.js App Router Route Handlers (app/api/**/route.ts) as the application backend, behind a thin controller to repository to service layering.
decisions.rationale: A single deployable full-stack app keeps the vertical slice small and typed end-to-end; file-based Route Handlers give a server-only API surface without running a separate backend process.

decisions.title: SQLite + better-sqlite3 behind a Repository Pattern
decisions.decision: Persist to SQLite via better-sqlite3, accessed only through a Repository Pattern so the storage engine can be swapped without touching controllers or UI.
decisions.rationale: SQLite is file-based and zero-ops for a single-node lab, and the repository boundary makes a later PostgreSQL swap a repository-only change (P2-04).

decisions.title: One provider abstraction with interchangeable backends
decisions.decision: Route all model access through a single ModelProvider interface with four interchangeable backends (openai-compatible, ollama, vllm, huggingface).
decisions.rationale: Provider-neutrality prevents lock-in to a single vendor and lets the Playground stream from any configured backend, configured at runtime from the database rather than hard-coded.

decisions.title: Store provider credentials by reference, never as values
decisions.decision: Store provider credentials as an env-var reference (api_key_ref); raw values live only in the local environment and are resolved at call time.
decisions.rationale: A public repository must never contain a secret; referencing credentials by name keeps the database and the repository free of credential values.

decisions.title: Training is launch-ready only in Milestone 1
decisions.decision: Milestone 1 ships training as launch-ready only: full configuration plus a real pre-flight check, with execution gated.
decisions.rationale: The lab must never claim training it has not run; gating execution keeps every metric honest and forbids fabricated results.

decisions.title: npm workspaces monorepo with a shared types package
decisions.decision: Structure the repository as an npm workspaces monorepo (apps/web, packages/shared) with a shared, type-only types package.
decisions.rationale: Native workspaces add no tooling and let the web app and the Python services share one authoritative type definition.

decisions.title: Data Factory as an explicit pipeline state machine
decisions.decision: Model data curation as an explicit state machine RAW to NORMALIZED to REVIEW_REQUIRED to APPROVED to TRAINING_READY, with REJECTED, enforced server-side.
decisions.rationale: An explicit, server-enforced state machine makes the provenance of every training record auditable and makes an illegal state jump impossible even when the API is called directly.

decisions.title: Gate model promotion through registry statuses
decisions.decision: Gate model promotion through registry statuses EXPERIMENT to CANDIDATE to ACCEPTED to DEPRECATED, enforced in the repository layer.
decisions.rationale: A model earns its version number: evaluation, not intent, is the gate, and enforcement belongs in the repository rather than only in the UI.

decisions.title: Restrict CORS on Python services to an explicit allow-list
decisions.decision: The Python FastAPI ML services allow CORS only from an explicit allow-list.
decisions.rationale: Wildcard CORS on an ML service is an avoidable exposure; an explicit allow-list is the safe default.

decisions.title: Root scripts delegate to workspaces; Next.js pinned at the repo root
decisions.decision: Root npm scripts delegate to the workspace, and Next.js is pinned at the repository root.
decisions.rationale: A single entry point per operation keeps CI and local usage identical and avoids version skew across workspaces.

decisions.title: Provider-neutral TrainingWorker abstraction with Kaggle as Worker #1
decisions.decision: Define a provider-neutral TrainingWorker interface; Kaggle is Worker #1, not the architecture.
decisions.rationale: The free-Kaggle worker must be replaceable; the interface, not the provider, is the durable contract.

decisions.title: The canonical Training Package as the portable training contract
decisions.decision: Define the canonical Training Package as the portable, reproducible training contract exported from the AI LAB.
decisions.rationale: A single content-addressed package makes a training run reproducible on any worker and decouples the lab from the training environment.

decisions.title: Content-addressed immutable dataset versions with deterministic hashed splits
decisions.decision: Version datasets by content address and produce deterministic, hashed TRAIN / VALIDATION / TEST splits.
decisions.rationale: Immutable, content-addressed versions and deterministic splits are what make an experiment re-runnable and its provenance verifiable.

decisions.title: Zero-cost artifact policy — optional private HF, local fallback, never GitHub
decisions.decision: Store model artifacts in an optional private Hugging Face repo with a complete local fallback; GitHub holds source and documentation only.
decisions.rationale: Artifacts must survive the ephemeral runtime at zero cost, and a public repository must never carry weights.

decisions.title: Zero monetary cost training policy (CEO mandate)
decisions.decision: Training must operate at zero monetary cost: free compute (Kaggle T4), free-tier storage, and a local fallback; no paid provider may become a dependency.
decisions.rationale: A binding CEO mandate: capability must not depend on a purchased GPU machine or a paid training provider.

decisions.title: Initial 800-example gold split cut at seed 3407
decisions.decision: Cut the first GHARIBO-Research-Gold-v0.1 split (640 / 80 / 80) at seed 3407.
decisions.rationale: Superseded. Its TEST split contained 10 of the 100 audited examples, so TEST was not genuinely held out, and the assignment was not reproducible from any committed source because the seed-3407 generator was never versioned. The decision was replaced by DEC-0017 (audit-aware deterministic split at seed 20260914).

decisions.title: Audit-aware deterministic gold split at seed 20260914
decisions.decision: Re-cut the split with a committed, audit-aware deterministic generator (seed 20260914) that quarantines the 100-example audit cohort into TRAIN + VALIDATION, guaranteeing audited ∩ TEST = 0.
decisions.rationale: The superseded seed-3407 TEST split was contaminated and not reproducible. A committed generator plus an audit-quarantine rule makes the split reproducible and genuinely holds TEST out.

decisions.title: Universal Commercial + Procurement Knowledge Graph as the library architecture
decisions.decision: Model the GHARIBO library as a Universal Commercial + Procurement Knowledge Graph with PRODUCTS, SERVICES and ORGANIZATIONS as first-class entities and evidence/provenance as first-class concepts.
decisions.rationale: A flat product catalog cannot express who supplies, installs, integrates and maintains a system, nor the evidence behind a commercial claim.

decisions.title: VOKA ↔ GHARIBO integration boundary behind an AI Gateway
decisions.decision: Integrate VOKA and GHARIBO only across an explicit AI Gateway boundary.
decisions.rationale: An explicit boundary keeps the two systems independently deployable and prevents VOKA's private commercial and transaction data from leaking into GHARIBO's public surface.

decisions.title: GHARIBO Master State as the canonical single source of truth
decisions.decision: Establish governance/GHARIBO_MASTER_STATE.json as the canonical machine-readable project state, with a deterministic generator, a validator and a generated human view.
decisions.rationale: A single validated source of truth stops the document set drifting from the code and makes a material decision official only once it is recorded, validated, documented and checkpointed.

roadmap.note: Recorded here as approved direction. NOTHING beyond the current milestone is executed or scheduled.

stages.name: GHARIBO-exp-001
purpose: establish a measurable baseline
teach structured evidence-grounded behaviour
schema adherence
provenance discipline
evidence to entity to relation construction
no-fabrication behaviour

stages.name: UCL FACTORY CHALLENGE
stages.method: After successful exp-001 evaluation, ask GHARIBO to produce approximately 300-500 NEW candidate records from a domain/system not clearly represented in the training examples.
stages.dataset: New candidate records from an under-represented domain (CANDIDATE until verified)
purpose: outputs remain CANDIDATE records until verified
validate identity, schema, evidence, provenance, relations, duplicates, unsupported claims and hallucinations
measure whether GHARIBO learned the PROCESS rather than memorized examples

stages.name: GHARIBO-Research-Gold-v0.2
stages.method: Built primarily from failures, hard cases, boundary cases, verified new generations, human-approved corrections and validator-approved difficult examples.
purpose: grow the dataset from difficulty, not volume
explicitly NOT volume for its own sake

stages.name: PREFERENCE TRAINING
stages.method: Generate multiple candidate outputs; use deterministic validators, evidence verification, judge evaluation and selective human review to create CHOSEN vs REJECTED; evaluate DPO or ORPO.
stages.dataset: Preference pairs derived from validated candidate outputs
purpose: create CHOSEN vs REJECTED pairs
evaluate DPO ORPO
do not commit to one method until benchmark evidence exists

stages.name: GHARIBO-exp-003
stages.method: GRPO / RLVR. Build the GHARIBO-UCL-Verifier Environment. Core principle: DO NOT ONLY TEACH GHARIBO THE ANSWER — CREATE A REAL ENVIRONMENT WITH SOURCES, RULES, VERIFIERS AND REWARDS.
stages.dataset: Verifier environment over sources, rules, verifiers and rewards
purpose: record the reward dimensions: schema validity, source validity, evidence fidelity, entity identity correctness, normalization correctness, relation integrity, provenance completeness, duplicate avoidance, unsupported-claim avoidance, hallucinated-field avoidance, correct abstention / NEEDS_REVIEW
record the severe penalties: fabricated evidence, fabricated fields, invented supplier relationships, broken provenance, unsupported authorization claims, false commercial facts

stages.name: AGENTIC TRAINING
stages.method: Future tool ecosystem may include Firecrawl, Hugging Face, GitHub, MCP tools, Verifiers, Atropos and controlled browser/search tools.
purpose: future agentic tool ecosystem
controlled browser/search tools

stages.name: CAPABILITY SPECIALIZATION
stages.method: Potential separate capability adapters, with a future runtime that may route tasks to specialized adapters/models.
purpose: potential separate capability adapters: Research / Knowledge Factory, Coding, VOKA Commercial, Engineering, Vision / Document Intelligence
do NOT implement now
the future runtime may route tasks to specialized adapters/models

knowledgeGraph.timeSensitivePolicy: Time-sensitive commercial data must NOT be treated as permanent model truth. It belongs in a live database, governed observation records, RAG, search, tools and supplier quotation history. GHARIBO learns HOW TO DISCOVER AND VERIFY, not memorize.
knowledgeGraph.selfTrainingGuardrail: GHARIBO MUST NOT blindly train on its own outputs; self-generated data must pass independent verification to prevent model collapse and self-reinforcement of errors.
